## Highlights

This is the first Xeno release with installers. Each one installs the whole client, self-contained: the `xeno`
command, the desktop app, and Xeno Agent, the tray agent. Xeno 0.2.0 is an alpha: APIs, configuration files, and
commands may change before 1.0.

- **Local and network models through one endpoint.** Apps on this machine call `http://127.0.0.1:11435` (OpenAI and
  Ollama compatible), and Xeno sends each model to a local provider or to the Xeno network.
- **Chat** with any local or network model in the web dashboard, desktop app, terminal app, CLI, and over MCP, with
  feedback and history.
- **Usage analytics**: latency, time to first token, tokens, and time by stage on every surface.
- **Desktop and terminal apps** with the same pages as the local web dashboard, and color palettes.
